observations: Qingbi final north passing-walk drawing visually matches neighboring head and body sizes; selected native figure bounds height343 vs adjacent340px, supplementary only, not an anatomy measurement.
No per-frame resizing: unmodified RGBA packing and fixed0.225 runtime scale, with explicit source foot coordinates and character-wide HP clearance.
Directly reviewed Songwol six attack phases in production eight-direction review and actual Canvas/WebGL visual screenshots.
limitations: Boss skills use a representative authored attack cycle retimed to existing contacts, not unique new art for every individual skill.
Projectiles, traps and combat VFX are rendered separately. Death uses a single authored pose with fade.
Five drawn views are mirrored to eight gameplay directions, so screen-side hand positions mirror.
Visual anatomy and size assessment is judgment; connectivity, hashes and numeric render assertions do not certify art quality. Minor generated robe/palette variation can remain.
